# Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Emphasis (BS)

---

The minimum requirement for the degree with an emphasis in mechanical engineering is 130 units.

### Biomedical Engineering

---

- BME 101 Introduction to Biomedical Engineering Units: 4
- BME 202 Control and Communication in the Nervous System Units: 4
- BME 210 Biomedical Computer Simulation Methods Units: 4
- BME 403L Physiological Systems Units: 4
- BME 404 Computational Neuromechanics Units: 4
- BME 413 Bioengineering Signals and Systems Units: 4
- BME 415 Regulation of Medical Products Units: 2

### Electrical and Computer Engineering

---

### Additional course work

---

Choose one course from the following:

- AME 309 Dynamics of Fluids Units: 4
- AME 416 Mechanics and Transport in Medicine and Biology Units: 4
- CHEM 322aL Organic Chemistry Units: 4
- MASC 310L Materials Behavior and Processing Units: 4

## Electives

---

Technical Electives: Complete 5 units as needed to complete 130 approved program units.

notes.text: The minimum requirement for the degree with an emphasis in mechanical engineering is 130 units. A cumulative grade point average of C (2.0) is required in all upper-division courses applied toward the major, regardless of the department in which the courses are taken. See common requirements for undergraduate degrees .
